o.text: From Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (gözgü). Equivalent to göz + -gü. Cognate with Kyrgyz күзгү (küzgü, “mirror”).
Internationalism via Russian респу́блика (respúblika), from Latin rēspūblica.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish طوی (toy), from Proto-Turkic *toy (“feast”). Compare Turkish toy, Gagauz toy.
From Proto-Turkic *soy- (“to skin, peel”). Compare Turkish soymak.
Analysable as qoca + -man. Compare Turkish kocaman.
